composition.serve_who: This sheet (AFT PLC, sheet 21/27) shows three WAGO 750-508 2-channel digital output modules at rack positions 13, 14, 15 (CPU 750-8213) in the AFT PLC I/O rack. Each module's two channels are individually labeled with the equipment and EV solenoid they drive: POS.13/DO-03 → transom door (EV 10.1A/B), POS.14/DO-04 → deck door (EV 10.2A/B), POS.15/DO-05 → mainsheet traveler (EV 10.3A/B). Per the mapping table these attach to 260-transom-door, 260-deck-door, and 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders (mainsheet traveller) respectively. The rack/module hardware itself (WAGO 750-508 modules, CPU 750-8213, positions 13-15, A1/A2 bus terminals, Connector Type I wiring convention) is shared PLC infrastructure and is recorded against the AFT PLC rack node, not the equipment nodes.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet explicitly labels DO-03 CH01/CH02 as 'transom door CLOSE (EV 10.1A)' and 'transom door OPEN (EV 10.1B)'. Mapping table confirms transom door -> 260-transom-door. Established facts already give EV-10.1 actuation type (PVEO) and relief settings (125/195 bar) for this node.

functions.label: Transom door hydraulic drive (CLOSE/OPEN) via PLC digital outputs
functions.what_it_does: The AFT PLC's 2DO module at rack position 13 (DO-03) issues the CLOSE and OPEN commands to the transom door's two PVEO on/off solenoid pilots (EV-10.1A/B), moving the door in the commanded direction; pressure relief on the A/B work ports (125/195 bar, established fact) protects the actuator against over-pressure in either direction.
functions.sheet_region: left column, rows B-E, module POS.13 labeled 2DO/DO-03
key_components: Connector Type I (4-pin circular field connector, see sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: PLC DO-03 CH01 (module POS.13, TYPE 750-508) energises solenoid EV-10.1A (PVEO ON/OFF, per hydraulic-sheet type) → pilots transom door cylinder A-port work section → door drives CLOSE; A/B relief valves (125/195 bar) dump excess back to tank via return line if pressure exceeds setting.
PLC DO-03 CH02 (module POS.13) energises solenoid EV-10.1B (PVEO ON/OFF) → pilots transom door cylinder B-port work section → door drives OPEN; same relief protection applies on the B side.
Both CH01 and CH02 de-energised → no pilot signal to EV-10.1A/B → door holds last position (no active drive).

functions.dry_data: CH01 voltage relative to module common (M) of DO-03/POS.13 = CLOSE command; CH02 relative to same common = OPEN command. No local switches/fuses shown on this sheet; PLC-only control.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet explicitly labels DO-04 CH01/CH02 as 'deck door OPEN (EV 10.2A)' and 'deck door CLOSE (EV 10.2B)'. No prior established facts exist for this node on other sheets; register has a dedicated 260-deck-door node.

functions.label: Deck door hydraulic drive (OPEN/CLOSE) via PLC digital outputs
functions.what_it_does: The AFT PLC's 2DO module at rack position 14 (DO-04) issues the OPEN and CLOSE commands to the deck door's solenoid pilots (EV-10.2A/B), driving the door in the commanded direction.
functions.sheet_region: middle column, rows B-E, module POS.14 labeled 2DO/DO-04
key_components: Connector Type I (4-pin circular field connector, see sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: PLC DO-04 CH01 (module POS.14, TYPE 750-508) energises solenoid EV-10.2A → pilots deck door cylinder work port → door drives OPEN.
PLC DO-04 CH02 (module POS.14) energises solenoid EV-10.2B → pilots deck door cylinder opposite work port → door drives CLOSE.
Both channels de-energised → no pilot signal → door holds last position.

functions.dry_data: CH01 voltage relative to module common (M) of DO-04/POS.14 = OPEN command; CH02 relative to same common = CLOSE command. No pressure relief values or actuation type (PVEO/PVED) legible on this sheet or established on prior sheets for this node.

functions.label: Mainsheet traveler hydraulic drive (TO PORT/TO STBD) via PLC digital outputs
functions.what_it_does: The AFT PLC's 2DO module at rack position 15 (DO-05) issues the TO-PORT and TO-STBD commands to the mainsheet traveler's solenoid pilots (EV-10.3A/B), sliding the traveler carriage across the track in the commanded direction.
functions.sheet_region: right column, rows B-E, module POS.15 labeled 2DO/DO-05
key_components: Connector Type I (4-pin circular field connector, see sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: PLC DO-05 CH01 (module POS.15, TYPE 750-508) energises solenoid EV-10.3A → pilots traveler cylinder work port → carriage moves TO PORT.
PLC DO-05 CH02 (module POS.15) energises solenoid EV-10.3B → pilots traveler cylinder opposite work port → carriage moves TO STBD.
Both channels de-energised → no pilot signal → traveler carriage holds last position.

functions.dry_data: CH01 voltage relative to module common (M) of DO-05/POS.15 = TO PORT command; CH02 relative to same common = TO STBD command. Actuation type of EV-10.3A/B not detailed on this sheet — keep as generic solenoid pilot per this sheet's evidence; consult hydraulic manifold sheet for PVEO/PVEU type if needed elsewhere.

facts: Rack inventory this sheet details: three 2-channel digital output modules, WAGO type 750-508, all under CPU 750-8213.
Module at rack position 13 = DO-03, driving transom door EV-10.1A/B.
Module at rack position 14 = DO-04, driving deck door EV-10.2A/B.
Module at rack position 15 = DO-05, driving mainsheet traveler EV-10.3A/B.

Each module has bus/supply terminals marked A1/A2 at the top, feeding into two independent output channels (CH01, CH02), each with +/- polarity terminals and an earth/ground terminal before the field wiring.
Each output channel connects to the field solenoid via a 4-pin circular 'Connector Type I' — full connector pinout is detailed on sheet 4, not this sheet.

Per-module common/reference: each 750-508 output module provides its own on-module common (M) terminal for its two channels — voltage on CH01/CH02 must be measured relative to that module's own common, not a shared rack-wide reference.
This sheet is a detail page (not the rack GA/index) — it documents modules at positions 13, 14, 15 only; positions 1-12 and any power-supply modules are documented elsewhere in the set.
No local switches, panel switches, or separate protective fuses/breakers shown for the individual valve output circuits on this sheet — control originates solely from the PLC digital outputs.

uncertainties: Deck door (260-deck-door) actuation type (PVEO vs PVED) and any pressure relief settings are not legible/present on this sheet and no established fact exists yet from other sheets — flag for hydraulic-sheet cross-check.

Mainsheet traveler EV-10.3A/B pilot device type (PVEO/PVEU) is not stated on this sheet; per cross-sheet consistency rule the type should be taken from the hydraulic manifold sheet, but that sheet's EV-10.3 entry was not present in the established facts provided — type left unspecified here rather than downgraded to generic solenoid.
